messages.author: James Kress
messages.body:
Using Amber 22 on a RHEL 8 system.  I had to go from RHEL 8.4 to 8.8 and
CUDA toolkit 11.4 to 11.8 due to a server malfunction.
Do I need to recompile Amber and amber tools or can I use the executables
generate previously?
Thanks for any assistance.
Jim Kress
-----Original Message-----
From: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer via AMBER <amber.ambermd.org>
Sent: Thursday, November 10, 2022 9:07 AM
To: David A Case <david.case.rutgers.edu>
Cc: AMBER Mailing List <amber.ambermd.org>
Subject: Re: [AMBER] Installation Problem
Dr. Case, the diff value is attached.
What do you think about the seriousness?
Yes, I think mdgx was built. I can try next to use the flag correctly
(without quotes) like Scott suggested.

messages.author: Scott Brozell
messages.body:
Hi,
Yes.
(There are a lot of if ands or buts; however, the simplest way to
guarantee that the new toolkit is used is to rebuild after running
clean_build
)
scott
